concern: لائیں (subjunctive, matching the parallel کریں/karen in the same clause) is rendered "laaye" (past tense) instead of the subjunctive "laayen", losing the mood match.
suggestion: Be-shak jo log imaan laayen aur bhale kaam karen un ke liye na khatm hone wala ajr hai

concern: ان کفار (far referent, "un kuffar") is rendered "in kuffar", though the same referent two words later (ان کے اعمال) is correctly "un ke aamaal" in the same clause.
suggestion: yaqeenan hum un kuffar ko un ke aamaal se khabardaar karenge
